raw.details:
Innovate. Develop. Transform the Future.

Where Ideas Become Innovation. Where Innovation Becomes Reality.

NEXORA AI 2026 is an online national-level technology and innovation hackathon designed to bring together creative thinkers, aspiring developers, technology enthusiasts, and student innovators from across India.

The hackathon challenges participants to identify real-world problems and transform their ideas into meaningful digital solutions using Artificial Intelligence, modern software technologies, and emerging innovations.

Whether you are an aspiring AI developer, programmer, designer, entrepreneur, or first-time innovator, this is your opportunity to showcase your creativity, technical knowledge, and problem-solving abilities.

Innovation Domains

Participants can explore and develop solutions across the following technology domains:

  • Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning: Intelligent systems, predictive solutions, and AI-powered applications.
  • AI Agents & Automation: Autonomous agents, smart assistants, and workflow automation.
  • Web Applications & Websites: Modern, scalable, and interactive digital platforms.
  • Mobile Application Development: Innovative Android and iOS applications.
  • Smartwatch & Wearable Technology: Smart wearable applications and connected solutions.
  • Software & SaaS Products: Productivity tools, platforms, and software-based innovations.
  • Smart Technology Solutions: IoT, connected devices, and emerging technologies.

Participants are encouraged to think beyond conventional solutions and explore innovative approaches.

Eligibility & Participation

  • Open to school students, college students, and university students across India.
  • Both individual and team participation are allowed.
  • Team Size: 1 member.
  • Participants from different academic backgrounds are welcome.
  • Both beginners and experienced developers can participate.

Competition Structure

Round 1 – Idea & Innovation Submission

Participants must submit an original project concept explaining:

  • Problem statement and its relevance.
  • Proposed solution and key features.
  • Technologies and AI tools involved.
  • Innovation and practical applications.
  • Expected impact and future possibilities.

Shortlisted ideas will qualify for the next round.

Round 2 – Project Development & Prototyping

Shortlisted participants must develop their proposed solutions into working prototypes or demonstrable products.

Participants may submit:

  • Project presentation (PPT/PDF).
  • Prototype or demonstration link.
  • Screenshots or supporting documentation.
  • Explanation of technical implementation.

Final Evaluation

Finalist projects will be reviewed by the evaluation team based on their innovation, technical implementation, practical usefulness, feasibility, and presentation.

Evaluation Criteria

Projects will be evaluated using the following weighted criteria:

Evaluation Parameter Weight
Innovation & Originality 25%
Technical Implementation 20%
Practical Usefulness 20%
Feasibility 15%
Presentation & Clarity 10%
Future Potential 10%
Total 100%

Awards & Recognition

Outstanding projects and participants will receive recognition through certificates.

  • 1st Position: Winner Certificate.
  • 2nd Position: First Runner-up Certificate.
  • 3rd Position: Second Runner-up Certificate.
  • Eligible Participants: Certificate of Participation.

Note: This is a certificate-based competition. No cash prizes are offered.

Official WhatsApp Group – Stay Connected!

Join the official NEXORA AI 2026 WhatsApp Group to stay informed throughout the competition.

WhatsApp Group Link: https://chat.whatsapp.com/JW3y0DnzGd64XZZGvIyuets=cl&p=a&mlu=4&ilr=4&iam=2

WhatsApp Group membership is for communication and announcements. Official registration and submissions must be completed through Unstop.

What Will You Receive in the Group?

  • Official announcements and important updates.
  • Registration and submission reminders.
  • Round-wise guidelines and instructions.
  • Competition deadlines and schedule updates.
  • Shortlisting announcements.
  • Final results and certificate-related updates.
  • Important communication from the organising team.

Participants are strongly encouraged to join the group and enable notifications to stay updated.

Rules & Guidelines

  • All project ideas and submissions must be original.
  • Plagiarism and unauthorised copying of projects are prohibited.
  • Participants must disclose the use of AI tools and externally developed components.
  • Projects must be relevant to the selected innovation domain.
  • Participants must follow the submission guidelines and specified deadlines.
  • Incomplete or late submissions may not be considered.
  • Participants must provide accurate registration information.
  • Evaluation decisions made by the organising and judging team will be final.

Why Participate?

  • Challenge yourself with real-world technology problems.
  • Explore Artificial Intelligence and emerging technologies.
  • Turn creative ideas into demonstrable solutions.
  • Showcase your technical and problem-solving abilities.
  • Gain recognition for your innovation.
  • Connect with fellow student innovators.

YOUR IDEAS. YOUR INNOVATION. YOUR FUTURE.

NEXORA AI 2026 – Innovate. Develop. Transform the Future.

Don't just imagine the future. Build something that contributes to it.
